def factor_size_gated_book_yield(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    book_yield = 1.0 / df_copy["pb_lf"].replace(0, np.nan)
    debt_ratio = df_copy["debttoassets"] / 100.0
    roe_decimal = df_copy["roe_ttm2"] / 100.0
    small_gate = df_copy["style_gate_size_small"].fillna(0)
    large_gate = df_copy["style_gate_size_large"].fillna(0)
    small_signal = book_yield * (1.0 - debt_ratio).clip(lower=0.0)
    large_signal = book_yield * roe_decimal.clip(lower=0)
    signal = np.where(small_gate == 1, small_signal, np.where(large_gate == 1, large_signal, book_yield))
    df_copy["factor_size_gated_book_yield"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_size_gated_book_yield"]
